text: Hydrate, set core priorities, and secure an early win.

framework.title: The 3-2-1 Morning
steps: Drink three full glasses of water.
Write down two non-negotiable daily priorities.
Execute one high-impact task for thirty minutes.

text: Clear distractions, set clear targets, and execute one uninterrupted block of focus.

framework.title: The 3-2-1 Tunnel Method
steps: Execute one ninety minute focus session

utilityLine: Try it today before starting your main project.
